**RULE: RUN MERGE with a 1 s gap cap (a record >1 s after the previous starts a new print), side = last-vs-bid/ask, close time = min(next print's time, last record + 1 s). CAUSAL, needs a 1 s timer.**

**Set suffix: `_CANG`** (sets TL3_ALN_AS_Lfb608c7b_CANG). Set families and what each used: `_CAN` = records merged on the same millisecond + side (tape flag) + price, ms-truncated stamps (superseded); `_CANQ` = contract-level prints (each contract one print), side last-vs-bid/ask (superseded, reference); `_CANR` = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask, first-record stamp (look-ahead, reference); `_CANC` = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask, causal close (next different print); `_CANG` = 1 s-cap run merge, causal close.
